candidates: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15 - Anonymous visitors can make the forum fetch pages and create a topic for any URL on the embeddable host.. Any request with a matching (spoofable) Referer and an unknown `embed_url` enqueues `retrieve_topic`. The throttle is keyed on the exact URL string, so changing a query string (`?a=1`, `?a=2`, ...) skips it. Each such request fetches the page and creates a new topic as `embed_by_username`, so anyone can flood the forum with topics and outbound requests. Fix: normalise the URL (drop the query and fragment), add a per-IP rate limit, and/or only create topics for URLs listed in the configured feed.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:11 - Remote and feed HTML is stored as raw_html and served unsanitised on the forum origin.. Feed content (after `CGI.unescapeHTML`) and fetched page content are saved with `cook_method: raw_html`. `Post#cook` then returns `raw` unchanged, and `best.html.erb` renders it with `raw post.cooked`. Any `<script>`, event handler or `javascript:` link in a feed item or on a page of the embeddable host is therefore served from the Discourse origin, which is stored XSS.

The `url` check makes this worse. `/^https?:\/\//` only anchors to the start of a line, so a value like `"javascript:alert(1)\nhttp://x"` passes. The URL is also put into `href='#{url}'` without escaping, so a `'` in it breaks out of the attribute.

Fix: run the imported HTML through a whitelist sanitiser before storing it, use `\A` in the regex, and escape `url` (`ERB::Util.h`). I could not check whether PostsController lets clients pass `cook_method`. If it does, any user can post raw HTML.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 - Protocol-relative URLs are rewritten into broken same-host paths.. `href.start_with?('/')` also matches protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example.com/img.png`. `sub(/^\/+/, '')` then strips both slashes, giving `http://host/cdn.example.com/img.png`, so images and links to other hosts break. Fix: leave values starting with `//` alone, or resolve them with `URI.join(url, href)`.

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 - The Disqus import loses its `--category` option and the original thread dates, and now fetches every thread over HTTP.. The change removes the `--category` option and the `created_at`/`category` that were passed to PostCreator. Imported topics now land in the default category and are dated now instead of the thread's original date. `import_remote` also downloads every thread link, so one unreachable or 404 page raises and aborts the whole import. Nothing in the request asks for this. Fix: keep the category and the creation date, and rescue fetch errors (falling back to the old permalink body).

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 - Feed items without a `content` element crash the whole poll.. Many RSS 2.0 items only have `<description>` and no `content`/`content:encoded`. For those, SimpleRSS returns `nil` for `i.content`, and `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError. The poll aborts on the first such item, no item is imported, and the job has retry disabled. The same exception also reaches `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, which calls this job inline. Fix: fall back to `i.description`, skip items with no content, and rescue errors per item.

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 - An unrelated, already-shipped migration is changed to `force: true`.. Adding `force: true` to `create_top_topics` makes it silently drop and recreate an existing `top_topics` table, along with its data, whenever it runs (for example a rerun or a schema rebuild). This is not part of the embedding feature. Fix: revert the change.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 - `Kernel#open` on a configurable URL can run shell commands.. `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` uses `Kernel#open`. A setting value that starts with `|` runs a shell command, so anyone who can change site settings gets command execution on the server. `import_remote` uses `open(url)` the same way, and the Disqus task passes it links taken from the XML file. Fix: use `URI.parse(url).open` / `OpenURI.open_uri` and only accept http(s) URLs.

app/models/topic_embed.rb:32 - The update path crashes when the embed's post no longer exists.. If the post behind an embed has been deleted, `embed.post` is nil. When the content changes, `PostRevisor.new(nil).revise!` then raises NoMethodError, which breaks every later feed poll at that item. Fix: guard against `post.nil?` and either recreate the post or remove the stale embed.

app/views/embed/best.html.erb:6 - `<%- end if %>` turns the next template output into the condition of the block.. In the compiled ERB, `end if` applies a postfix `if` whose condition is the following buffer append. That append therefore runs before the if/else body, which only renders correctly by accident. Fix: use `<%- end %>`.
